title: Saqi's Call
persian:
الا یا ایها الساقی ادر کاسا و ناولها
که عشق آسان نمود اول ولی افتاد مشکل ها
translation:
Cupbearer, keep the goblet turning and place it at our lips;
Love looked easy at sunrise, yet soon revealed its knots.
faal: A fresh desire is awakening. Welcome it, but do not assume the road will stay simple. Patience is part of the blessing.

title: Angelic Brew
persian:
دوش دیدم که ملائک در میخانه زدند
گل آدم بسرشتند و به پیمانه زدند
translation:
Last night I saw the angels knock upon the tavern door;
They kneaded Adam's clay and measured it with the wine cup.
faal: The unseen is collaborating on your behalf. Allow a sacred mix of destiny and delight to remake your plans.

title: Snared Heart
persian:
هر که دلارام دید از دلش آرام رفت
چشم ندارد خلاص هر که در این دام رفت
translation:
Whoever glimpsed that gentle beloved lost the calm of the heart;
No eye finds release once it steps inside this snare.
faal: Attachment is transforming you. Instead of fighting the pull, learn from it and let devotion refine your character.

title: Separation Ends
persian:
روز هجران و شب فرقت یار آخر شد
زدم این فال و گذشت اختر و کار آخر شد
translation:
The day of separation and the night of parting finally ended;
I cast this omen and the turning star announced the work is done.
faal: Cycles of waiting are closing. Prepare your space and spirit for reunion, resolution, or long-awaited news.

title: Bury the Gloom
persian:
ساقیا برخیز و در ده جام را
خاک بر سر کن غم ایام را
translation:
Cupbearer, rise and fill the cup once more;
Cover the head of sorrowful days with dust and send them off.
faal: Change the atmosphere yourself. A bold gesture or celebration will break the stale mood and invite better fortune.

title: Royal Heart
persian:
ای دل غلام شاه جهان باش و شاه باش
پیوسته در حمایت لطف اله باش
translation:
O heart, be both servant and king under the Sovereign of the world;
Stay forever sheltered inside divine kindness.
faal: Lead with humility and courage at the same time. Aligning with a higher ethic gives you both authority and safety.

title: Moonlit Promise
persian:
رسید مژده که ایام غم نخواهد ماند
چنان نماند چنین نیز هم نخواهد ماند
translation:
Glad tidings came that the days of sorrow will not remain;
As it once was not, so even this will not remain.
faal: This chapter is ending. Keep your rituals steady and let hope make actual plans for the better days approaching.

title: Scatter Blossoms
persian:
بیا تا گل بر افشانیم و می در ساغر اندازیم
فلک را سقف بشکافیم و طرحی نو در اندازیم
translation:
Come, let us scatter roses and pour wine into the cup;
Let us tear the roof of the heavens and sketch a brand-new design.
faal: It is time to innovate. Gather your allies, celebrate, and disrupt tired limits with joyful courage.

title: Primordial Light
persian:
در ازل پرتو حسنت ز تجلی دم زد
عشق پیدا شد و آتش به همه عالم زد
translation:
At pre-eternity the ray of your beauty flashed;
Love appeared and set the entire cosmos aflame.
faal: A timeless inspiration is touching you now. Let passion ignite your craft or calling without apology.

title: Morning Breeze
persian:
نسیم باد صبا دوشم آگهی آورد
که روز محنت و غم رو به کوتهی آورد
translation:
The dawn breeze visited me last night with news;
It said the days of toil and grief are bending toward an end.
faal: Relief is already traveling your way. Keep your routines steady and welcome the first sign of ease.

title: Exile Drum
persian:
مرا در منزل جانان چه امن عیش چون هر دم
جرس فریاد می دارد که بربندید محمل ها
translation:
How can I rest in the beloved's abode when every moment
The caravan bell cries, 'Pack up the litters now!'
faal: Do not cling to temporary comfort. Be ready to move quickly when destiny signals a new migration.

title: Stormed Night
persian:
شب تاریک و بیم موج و گردابی چنین هایل
کجا دانند حال ما سبکباران ساحل ها
translation:
A dark night, fearful waves, a whirlpool wild and deep;
How could the light travellers on shore know what we endure?
faal: Your struggle is valid even if others do not see it. Stay focused on navigation rather than outside opinions.

title: Vanishing Heart
persian:
دل می رود ز دستم صاحب دلان خدا را
دردا که راز پنهان خواهد شد آشکارا
translation:
My heart is slipping from my grasp, O keepers of hearts;
Alas, this hidden secret is about to shine in the open.
faal: Truth wants expression. Share authentically before circumstances reveal what you prefer to guide yourself.

title: Shirazi Promise
persian:
اگر آن ترک شیرازی به دست آرد دل ما را
به خال هندویش بخشم سمرقند و بخارا را
translation:
If that Shirazi Turk were to claim my heart,
I would gift Samarkand and Bukhara for the mole upon her cheek.
faal: Value can shift overnight. Be willing to trade old ambitions for the single bond or idea that truly moves you.

title: Joseph Returns
persian:
یوسف گمگشته باز آید به کنعان غم مخور
کلبه احزان شود روزی گلستان غم مخور
translation:
The lost Joseph returns to Canaan, do not grieve;
The hut of sorrows will one day turn to a garden, do not grieve.
faal: Hope is justified. A missing piece, person, or resource is on the way back once you keep faith.

title: Desert Envoy
persian:
صبا به لطف بگو آن غزال رعنا را
که سر به کوه و بیابان تو داده ای ما را
translation:
Kind breeze, tell that graceful gazelle;
Your wandering has driven us into mountains and deserts.
faal: Send the message you have been holding. Honest communication will shorten the distance between hearts.

title: Listen Well
persian:
چو بشنوی سخن اهل دل مگو که خطاست
سخن شناس نه ای جان من خطا اینجاست
translation:
When you hear the speech of heart-people, do not call it wrong;
My dear, the error lies in not knowing the language of the soul.
faal: Guidance may sound unfamiliar. Suspend judgment and learn the dialect of intuition before deciding.

title: Saffron Breeze
persian:
نفس باد صبا مشک فشان خواهد شد
عالم پیر دگر باره جوان خواهد شد
translation:
The breath of the dawn breeze will scatter musk;
The old world will once again turn young.
faal: Fresh energy is arriving. Open windows, refresh your space, and be ready to step into rejuvenated momentum.

title: Dawn Deliverance
persian:
دوش وقت سحر از غصه نجاتم دادند
و اندر آن ظلمت شب آب حیاتم دادند
translation:
At the break of last night they freed me from sorrow;
In that darkness they handed me the water of life.
faal: Relief comes when you rise before dawn with honesty. Pour out your worries, then accept the quiet solution being offered.

title: Tear-Stained Eyes
persian:
ز گریه مردم چشمم نشسته در خون است
ببین که در طلبت حال مردمان چون است
translation:
From endless weeping, the people of my eyes are seated in blood;
See what becomes of lovers who keep searching for you.
faal: Emotion is not weakness. Let your sincerity show, but also soothe yourself with rest and trusted company.

title: Scarlet Pledge
persian:
گر چه ما بندگان پادشهیم
پادشاهان ملک صبحگهیم
translation:
Though we appear as servants to the sovereign,
We are the kings of dawn's domain.
faal: Remember your sovereignty. Serve with grace, but do not surrender the authority of your inner light.

title: Emerald Lattice
persian:
بیا که ترک فلک خوان روزه غارت کرد
هلال عید به دور قدح اشارت کرد
translation:
Come, for the heavens have broken their fast of abstinence;
The crescent of Eid just pointed toward the wine cup.
faal: A celebration beckons. Say yes to the invitation and let community refill your empty cup.

title: Hidden Orchard
persian:
به باغ تازه کن ای بلبل آشفتگی
که گل نهان شده در پردهٔ حیا امروز
translation:
Refresh the garden, O restless nightingale;
The shy blossom hides today behind a veil of modesty.
faal: Gentle attention will coax a shy opportunity forward. Patience and beauty go hand in hand.

title: Amber Lullaby
persian:
دلا بسوز که سوز تو کارها بکند
نیهال خشک شبی خوشهٔ تر انجارد
translation:
O heart, burn—your burning accomplishes wonders;
Even a dry sapling can bear fresh fruit in one night.
faal: Your passion still holds power. Apply it wisely and expect tangible change, even where hope felt gone.

title: Celestial Caravan
persian:
فلک به مردم نادان دهد زمام مراد
تو اهل فضلی و دانش همین گناهت بس
translation:
Fate hands the reins of desire to the ignorant crowd;
You are all merit and knowledge—alas, that alone counts as your fault.
faal: Stop waiting for fairness. Chart your own caravan and let wisdom—not permission—lead the route.

title: Rosewater Echo
persian:
چو بشنوی سخن اهل دل مگو که خطاست
سخن شناس نه ای جان من خطا اینجاست
translation:
When you hear the speech of heart-people, do not cry ‘wrong’;
My dear, the mistake is only that you do not speak the language of the soul.
faal: An intuitive message is repeating. Learn its tone instead of debating its grammar.

title: Velvet Pilgrim
persian:
به کوی میکده یا رب سحر چه افتاد است
که جوش شاهد و ساقی و بوی باده بود
translation:
O Lord, what happened at the tavern's alley at dawn?
Witnesses stirred, the cupbearer glowed, and the wine’s scent rose.
faal: Magic brews before sunrise. Visit the place that feeds your spirit and let dawn conspire in your favor.

title: Jade Horizon
persian:
به آب دیده بشوییم خرقه‌های مستان
اگر چه حاصل عمرم فراق یاران بود
translation:
Let us wash the revelers’ robes with rivers of tears;
Though most of life has passed in separation from friends.
faal: Cleansing grief is sacred. Ritualize your tears, then step forward wrapped in newly blessed garments.

title: Opal Lantern
persian:
بیا که رونق این کارخانه کم نشود
به زهد همچو تویی یا به فسق همچون من
translation:
Come, for the splendor of this workshop never fades;
Neither by your piety nor by my mischief.
faal: The universe can handle your honesty. Show up as you are—the light you carry matters more than your perfection.
